I am like 80%  done with my  my ki cad model for my PCB , which looks amazing for my first ever PCB done. I routed most of the traces which took a while and added all the holes  to the board. It was hard to get all the holes to connected without touching the other traces but I just used a copper fill on the back layer for GND,
 so it cleaned up the board quite well.  I had to also account for spacing of the modules, which took some time to reconnect the traces as well. So far the PCB looks amazing and I hope it works!! Overall it was  a hard time dong this just because of having to reorute the traces, as they are not allowed to touch each other. I will continue tracing the rest of the pads and then add some lables, get the bill of the materals, work on my rep and then maybe add some cool art !!

### 2026-10-10 – I ran drc and made sure all traces worked and were connected. After this, I used claude to generate AI art for my pcb which i placed on the bacK. I also added lables everywhere and removed some parts

**6h**

I ran drc and made sure all traces worked and were connected. After this, I used claude to generate AI art for my pcb which i placed on the bacK. I also added lables everywhere and removed some parts to make sure everything can connect I got my bom together, which puts me right in budget, but shaping the pcb is so much more expensive coming in at 30 bucks for shipping here to the UAE
